Name: StardewOpenWorld Vanilla Maps
Author: AtlasV1224
Description:
This is just a little personal experiment to test the capabilities of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36906]StardewOpenWorld[/url]﻿, it is no way polished, optimised or compatable with anything (at this point not even itself) and is missing every warp and other things that make it a working map

With the newest build of StardewOpenWorld, tile properties may be fixed and so I'll be jumping back in soon ish to restore warps and plenty of other missing features.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36906]StardewOpenWorld[/url]﻿ (obviously)
